name: Roman Trahtenberg: V poiskah ideal'nogo anekdota
storyline: A fateful accident throws Roman into a whirlwind of tragic events. In a nightclub, he meets Alisa, a beautiful, intelligent woman, and the sole heir to an eccentric millionaire. Money holds no interest for our knight without a cape. A page from an ancient joke book is at stake. Whoever reads it will forever change their understanding of humor and achieve unprecedented enlightenment. Today, humor is a lucrative and dangerous business. Besides Roman, a mysterious cult of entertainers is hunting for the collectible page. Who will need their old jokes after the "perfect joke" is published? Kidnappings, blackmail, the complete destruction of civilization... Only the Chosen One can stop the sinister cultists.
summary: A humorous quest that lets you experience a few days in the life of a famous Russian showman of the 2000s.
